blocker_summary: Stage 1 uncertainty variable DeltaE = kWhDelivered - kWhRequested cannot be computed from publicly accessible data alone. kWhRequested is only present in the session-level JSON returned by the live ACN API, which is gated by a registered token whose issuance is human-mediated. Until the user supplies a token or approves a Stage 1 amendment, no further Stage 2 work (cleaning, splits, uncertainty distributions, scenario generation) can proceed.
